annotations.title: Ask a human to review (Oversight Key)

description: Ask a real human to review an AI decision before acting on it (EU AI Act Article 14). Returns a review link to send to the person (or two people for a Two-Person Key, Article 14(5)). They type their reasoning live; sebbi.pro proves it was a human, measures how long they spent and seals the result. Poll sebbi_oversight_status and act only when it is CONFIRMED.
